topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: Sitting here, coffee long gone cold, I can't help but savor the silence. Just cracked a case where a pair of siblings walked into my office, both eyes red, voices tight, inheriting nothing but a house and a load of old family secrets. They wanted to know what was really in that dusty attic, what had their lawyer so spooked he wouldn’t even step inside. Took a week, dusted off more than just the cobwebs. Found a chest, swaps and schemes from decades back, enough to make any respectable crook blush. But in the end, I handed it all over, told them the truth, straight up. They didn't walk away rich, but they understood the weight of what they inherited. Some things, you just can’t put a price on.
